decisions: PatentExpirationOpportunity is a standalone JSON-safe contract because expiration evidence is not itself a Gap or a freedom-to-operate opinion.

The analyzer accepts structured metadata and explicit text containing a patent identifier plus a stated expiration date; it preserves the supplied date and jurisdiction instead of deriving legal status from the current date.
Generated opportunity statements explicitly require legal-status, maintenance and claim-scope verification; the module never asserts freedom to operate.
Missing or invalid expiration evidence is rejected; the module remains local and does not query patent registries or write production data.
remaining_risks: Date parsing accepts year, year-month and ISO year-month-day strings but does not validate jurisdiction-specific patent term rules.
Text extraction supports common publication prefixes and English expiration cues only; registry-specific identifiers require structured metadata.
limitations: No network, credentials, external dependencies, registry lookup or production write was used.
